_source: Trimmed snapshot of the public shadcn/ui registry (ui.shadcn.com), written by hand for benchmarking. Regenerate a real one with `npx shadcn@latest build` and point the shadcn or static-json adapter at it.
guidelines: Components are copied into the project and owned there. Style with the CSS variables in the theme, never with literal colours. Compose primitives rather than adding a dependency for a control the primitives already reach.

components.name: Button
components.description: Action trigger, also the trigger surface other primitives are anchored to
components.accessibility: Renders a native button. Focus ring uses the ring token. `asChild` forwards props to the child so the child keeps its own semantics.
components.usage: Use asChild when the button has to be another element, such as a popover trigger or a link.
components.avoid: Do not restyle with literal colours; the variants carry the theme.

components.name: Calendar
components.description: Date grid built on react-day-picker; supports single, multiple and range selection
components.accessibility: Grid semantics and arrow-key navigation come from react-day-picker. The selected range is announced per day cell.
components.usage: mode="range" selects a start and an end date in one grid. numberOfMonths=2 shows two months side by side.
components.avoid: Not a form field on its own: it has no trigger, no label and no popover. Pair it with Popover and Button.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Floating container anchored to a trigger, built on Radix Popover
components.accessibility: Focus moves into the content on open and returns to the trigger on close. Escape closes.
components.usage: PopoverTrigger with asChild keeps your own Button as the trigger.
components.avoid: Do not use for destructive confirmation; it is dismissible by clicking away.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal overlay for a focused task
components.accessibility: Focus trapped while open, Escape closes, DialogTitle is required as the accessible name.
components.usage: For a task the user completes without losing the page behind it.
components.avoid: Not for confirming a destructive action; AlertDialog carries the right role and the deliberate dismissal.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: Modal that interrupts for a confirmation and cannot be dismissed by clicking outside
components.accessibility: role=alertdialog. AlertDialogAction and AlertDialogCancel are the only exits; there is no outside-click dismissal.
components.usage: Destructive or irreversible confirmations. Put the consequence in AlertDialogDescription.
components.avoid: Do not use for routine forms; it takes the user hostage by design.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Sheet that slides from an edge, built on Vaul
components.accessibility: Drag-to-dismiss is exposed to pointer input; keyboard users dismiss with Escape.
components.usage: Mobile-first surfaces where a full modal is heavier than the task.
components.avoid: Drag-to-dismiss makes it wrong for confirmations: the user can dismiss it by accident.

components.name: Sheet
components.description: Side panel built on Radix Dialog
components.accessibility: Dialog semantics with an edge-anchored position. SheetTitle is the accessible name.
components.usage: Navigation and filters that would crowd the page at small widths.
components.avoid: Do not nest inside another modal surface.

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line text field
components.accessibility: Pair with Label. aria-invalid is styled through the theme.
components.usage: Free text and numbers.
components.avoid: type="date" hands the control to the browser, which ignores the theme, the locale rules and the range semantics the Calendar already has.

components.name: Label
components.description: Accessible label bound to a control
components.accessibility: Built on Radix Label, so clicking it focuses the control.
components.usage: Every input gets one, visible or visually hidden.
components.avoid: A placeholder is not a label.

components.name: Select
components.description: Listbox for choosing one value from an enumerable set
components.accessibility: Radix Select: typeahead, arrow keys, and the trigger is labelled by its value.
components.usage: Short, known sets of options.
components.avoid: Dates are not an enumerable set; do not build one out of three Selects.

components.name: Form
components.description: react-hook-form bindings: FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage
components.accessibility: FormMessage is wired to the control through aria-describedby and aria-invalid, so the error is announced rather than only seen.
components.usage: Any field that can be invalid. FormMessage renders the validation error in the destructive colour.
components.avoid: Do not render your own error paragraph next to a field; it loses the wiring.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Static, in-page message block
components.accessibility: AlertTitle and AlertDescription carry the text. Add role="alert" when it appears in response to an action.
components.usage: Form-level errors and standing notices.
components.avoid: Not for per-field validation; that is FormMessage.

components.name: Table
components.description: Styled table primitives: TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption
components.accessibility: Real table semantics, so rows and headers are navigable by assistive technology.
components.usage: Tabular data. TableCaption names the table.
components.avoid: Do not rebuild rows out of divs.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status or count marker
components.accessibility: Decorative unless the text carries meaning; then keep it in the reading order.
components.usage: Status next to a row or a title.
components.avoid: Colour alone does not carry the status; keep the word.

components.name: Card
components.description: Surface container with header, content and footer slots
components.accessibility: A container, not a landmark. Heading levels come from your content.
components.usage: Grouping related content on a page.
components.avoid: Do not nest cards to create depth; use spacing.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Binary control, built on Radix Checkbox
components.accessibility: Space toggles. Pair with Label.
components.usage: Multiple independent choices.
components.avoid: Do not use for a single on/off setting that applies immediately; that is Switch.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Immediate on/off control
components.accessibility: role=switch with the state announced.
components.usage: Settings that take effect on change.
components.avoid: Not inside a form that needs a submit step; that is Checkbox.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Switch between panels of one surface
components.accessibility: Radix Tabs: arrow-key roving focus, panels wired with aria-controls.
components.usage: Peer views of the same object.
components.avoid: Not navigation between pages.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Hover and focus hint
components.accessibility: Opens on focus as well as hover. Never the only place a name lives.
components.usage: Icon-only controls, as a supplement to an accessible name.
components.avoid: Not on touch: there is no hover. Do not put essential text in one.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: Menu of actions anchored to a trigger
components.accessibility: Radix menu semantics: roving focus, typeahead, Escape closes and returns focus.
components.usage: Row actions and overflow menus, including collapsed toolbar actions.
components.avoid: Not for form controls; menu items are not fields.

components.name: Separator
components.description: Rule between groups
components.accessibility: decorative=false exposes it as a separator to assistive technology.
components.usage: Between toolbar groups and list sections.
components.avoid: Do not use a bordered div.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Loading placeholder
components.accessibility: Mark the region aria-busy while skeletons are shown.
components.usage: Table and card loading states.
components.avoid: Not for actions in flight; that is the button's disabled state.

components.name: Sonner
components.description: Toast notifications (the toast() function and the Toaster mount)
components.accessibility: Rendered into a live region so the message is announced.
components.usage: Confirmation after an action completes.
components.avoid: Not for errors the user has to act on; keep those in the page.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.description: Scrollable region with themed scrollbars
components.accessibility: Keeps keyboard scrolling; the viewport stays focusable.
components.usage: Long menus and lists inside a bounded surface.
components.avoid: Do not wrap the page in one.

patterns.name: DatePicker
patterns.description: Documented composition, not a component: Popover + Button trigger + Calendar. mode="range" on the Calendar makes it a date range picker.
patterns.usage: The registry ships no DatePicker component. Copy this composition into the feature and keep the range state in the form.
patterns.avoid: Do not add a date-picker dependency; the Calendar already selects ranges.

patterns.name: Combobox
patterns.usage: Option sets too long for Select.
patterns.avoid: Do not use for free text.

patterns.name: DataTable
patterns.description: Table + TanStack Table: sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection
patterns.usage: Lists that need sorting or filtering. The filter row is part of this pattern.
patterns.avoid: Do not hand-roll sorting state next to a plain Table.
